integrity: Analytical proof and self-contained exact-rational check included. A published prior art equivalence remains possible; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to all-active balanced configurations of the globally coupled Stuart–Landau flow with strictly positive real coupling and no reactive/Kerr terms; no global stability or nonlinear bifurcation is claimed.
title: Complete linearized inertia of balanced polygonal Stuart–Landau states under dissipative mean-field coupling
